replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset while retaining as much variance as possible. To perform PCA, you first standardize the data, then compute the covariance matrix, and then find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. The eigenvectors with the highest eigenvalues are the principal components. You can then project the data onto the principal components to reduce the dimensionality.
